subject: Transportation Systems
title: Driverless Trains
description: A micro-lesson that makes Driverless Trains usable.

hook.text: More than 60 metro lines worldwide now run with no human driver at all.

buildup.text: Sensors, computers, and communication systems control speed, stopping, and door operation.

discovery.text: Driverless trains can run closer together and more frequently because computers react faster.

twist.text: The biggest challenge isn't technology—it's convincing passengers to trust a train without a driver.

climax.text: Dubai, Copenhagen, and Singapore run fully driverless metros. Passengers barely notice.

punchline.text: The safest driver might be no driver at all.

quiz.question: What is the main advantage of driverless metro trains?
options: They can run more frequently with shorter gaps
